facts.text: The class controls and configures the Thorlabs MTD415T digital temperature controller over a serial port
The constructor passes the port and baudrate 115200 to SerialDevice
SerialDevice opens the port with serial_for_url(port, baudrate=baudrate, **kwargs)
A query appends '?' to the setting name and retries once after 100 ms when the reply is 'unknown command'
write appends a newline to the bytes and read returns one line of the serial port
idn queries the setting 'm' and strips the reply
uid queries the setting 'u' and strips the reply
temp queries 'Te' and divides the reply by 1000, so it is a temperature in degrees Celsius
temp_setpoint queries 'T' and divides the reply by 1000; the docstring states 5.000 to 45.000 degrees Celsius
The temperature setpoint setter validates the range 5 to 45 degrees Celsius and writes 'T' with the value in millidegrees
tec_current queries 'A' and divides the reply by 1000, so it is a current in amperes
tec_voltage queries 'U' and divides the reply by 1000, so it is a voltage in volts
tec_current_limit queries 'L' and divides the reply by 1000; its setter range is 0.2 to 2 amperes
error_flags queries 'E', decodes the reply as 16 binary digits and returns the bits with the least significant bit first
The error register bits are the MTD415T datasheet errors (not enabled, sensor, TEC, range and command errors)
errors returns the text of every error bit that is set
is_open reports whether the serial port is open
The README describes the repository as a wrapper for the Thorlabs MTD415T OEM temperature controller module
